# ICP Intelligence

> ICP Intelligence is a free web app and AI connector with nine ideal customer profile tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for founders and demand generation heads. Give it your best customers, deals and market numbers, and it returns an ICP, TAM, SAM and SOM, and account priorities. Add https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in.

- Web app (no sign-in): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Hosted version 1.2.27 with 9 tools. Local stdio command: `npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/icp-intelligence-mcp`. npm latest on 15 November 2026: 1.2.26.
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Helix skills packages: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [ICP Deep Dive](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-deep-dive/) (`icp_deep_dive`): Helps you decide which customers to go after next. You give your best customers, as a list (industry, size, contract value, sales cycle, tech stack, buying trigger, champion title) or in your own words. You get the patterns they share, with ties named as ties, the budget shown as the contract value range seen in your customers, recommendations, and sector notes when your inputs name a supported sector. It works only from what you give and looks nothing up.
- [ICP Scoring Model](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-scoring-model/) (`icp_scoring_model`): Helps you decide which leads are worth a seller's time. You give the criteria that matter, how important each one is and, if you know it, what goes with success. You get a lead scoring template: example point weights set by importance level, example points for each value you list, a scorecard and tier bands to adjust, with sector notes when your inputs name a supported sector. Your success pattern is matched to your criteria; it does not set the weights. Ask for held-back test counts and the pre-agreed stop rule when a model has been tested.
- [Buyer Group Analyzer](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/buyer-group-analyzer/) (`buyer_group_analyzer`): Helps you decide who else must agree before a deal can close. You give what you sell, the deal size, the company size, your champion and any stakeholders you know. You get a buying group map with your stakeholders placed by their titles (economic buyer, technical evaluator, reviewers, users), each role's concern and message prompts, an influence map and discovery questions, with sector roles and questions when your inputs name a supported sector. Roles from titles are hypotheses to confirm.
- [TAM SAM SOM Calculator](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/tam-sam-som-calculator/) (`tam_sam_som_calculator`): Helps you decide how big your market is, counted bottom up. You give how many companies could buy and your annual contract value in dollars, plus your ICP match rate and year 1 share if you have them. You get TAM, SAM and SOM with the arithmetic and assumptions shown and a summary for an investor deck. It is a calculator, not a data source: a rate you leave out is filled with a labelled example, and sector notes are added when your inputs name a supported sector.
- [Lookalike Signal Generator](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/lookalike-signal-generator/) (`lookalike_signal_generator`): Helps you decide how to find more accounts like your best ones. You give your ICP's company profile, technologies, champion titles and buying triggers, and optionally what you sell and the platforms you use. You get targeting criteria and search queries for each platform, one signal for each trigger, and search keywords from what you sell and the sector. It writes criteria, not data: it finds no companies or contacts.
- [Account Prioritization](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/account-prioritization/) (`account_prioritization`): Helps you decide which accounts to work first. You give your accounts with fit, intent and relationship scores from 0 to 100 and a timing, plus optional weights. You get a ranked list from a weighted score, with a tier for each account, the points its timing earned and the factor that added the most points.
- [ICP Gap Analysis](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-gap-analysis/) (`icp_gap_analysis`): Helps you decide whether you are selling to the customers you meant to. You give your current customer base, your ideal customer profile and, if you have them, current and target metrics. You get what the ideal profile has that the current base lacks, metric gaps from your own figures, causes to check and actions that fit your business model, with sector notes when your inputs name a supported sector.
- [ICP Evolution Tracker](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-evolution-tracker/) (`icp_evolution_tracker`): Helps you decide whether your ICP should change after recent wins and losses. You give your current ICP, recent wins, recent losses and market changes. You get a candidate change for each (an addition to test, a disqualifier to test, an implication to check), a draft of the updated ICP, the roles your ICP does not name, the loss reasons to tag and what to pull from your CRM. It does not compute win rates; check each candidate against your CRM.
- [ICP Interview Synthesizer](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-interview-synthesizer/) (`icp_interview_synthesizer`): Helps you decide what your customer interviews mean for your ICP. You give structured notes, one per interview: the customer, the role, pain points, buying triggers, value realized and key quotes. You get the pain points, objections, buying triggers, value realized and champion roles across the interviews, quotes kept word for word, discovery questions and sector notes. It does not take full transcripts; give only the points and quotes you want analyzed.

## Questions and answers

### What is ICP Intelligence?

ICP Intelligence is a free web app and AI connector with nine ideal customer profile tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for founders and demand generation heads. Give it your best customers, deals and market numbers, and it returns an ICP, TAM, SAM and SOM, and account priorities. Add https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in.

### Is ICP Intelligence free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the ICP Intelligence code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. What you type and the answer are not stored, and nothing you type is logged. Only an anonymous count of tool calls is kept. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use ICP Intelligence in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it ICP Intelligence, paste https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Connect your app covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, the brand he has worked under in Bengaluru since 2022. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/icp-intelligence-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is ICP Intelligence not ideal for?

Teams looking for a list of companies to target: the tools describe and score profiles from your data but find no companies. Market sizing without your own numbers: TAM, SAM and SOM are built from the figures you enter; an ICP match rate or market share you leave out is filled with a labelled example (30% and 3%). Teams that need saved models or CRM sync: answers are not stored and no CRM is connected.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp/issues.

## Buyer routes

- [All Helix tools](https://tools.gtmhelix.com/tools/): 52 tools and 37 different skills, 89 in all, in six connectors and nine plugins.
- [Build a B2B ICP scoring model](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-scoring-model/): Build a B2B account fit scoring model from the customers and deals you know. Describe the segment, buying roles and fit signals, then review the proposed criteria and weights with sales. Test those choices against won and lost accounts before using the model to decide which leads receive attention.
- [Tam Sam Som Calculator](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/tam-sam-som-calculator/): Size one B2B market from the accounts that could buy and their annual contract value. Apply your fit and expected share assumptions to see TAM, SAM and SOM, then compare the result with the target. Replace example rates with your own evidence and check whether sales can reach and win those accounts.
- [Market Sizing Lab](https://helix-gtm-consulting-market-sizing-lab.shashwat-helix-gtm.chatgpt.site/): Compare team assumptions, then continue in ICP Intelligence.
